PLAN "PCOS Strength & Metabolic Health — 12 Week Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve insulin sensitivity and body composition via resistance training"
  GOAL secondary hypertrophy:
    name "Build lean muscle to support glucose disposal"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Moderate aerobic conditioning without overtraining"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Movement Quality" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          bodyweight_squat 2x10
          glute_bridge 2x12
          leg_swings 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
          arm_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          bird_dog 2x10
          cat_cow 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rest 45 seconds

          walking 10m
          pigeon_pose 1m
